title: Fans Choose JENNIE’s ‘Fallen Angel’ as This Week’s Favorite New Music
summary: JENNIE's new digital EP brought in more than 82% of the vote.
contentText:
Fallen Angel , JENNIE ‘s latest solo release, tops this week’s new music poll.

Listeners voted in a poll published Friday (Aug. 28)  on Billboard , choosing the BLACKPINK star’s new EP as their favorite new music.

Fallen Angel rose above a number of new releases this week — from music acts including Olivia Rodrigo, Ky-Mani Marley, Alex Warren, Alabama Shakes and more. At the poll’s closing time on Sunday, JENNIE’s new EP came out on top with more than 82% of the vote.

Fallen Angel is JENNIE’s first solo collection since last year’s full-length solo debut ( Ruby ). Led by the single “Less Than a Lover,” the EP arrives via ODDATELIER and Columbia Records.

The Fallen Angel rollout continued Friday (Aug. 28) with the acoustic-pop leaning “Fallen Angel” (alongside a dark and dreamy music video, seen above). “Less Than a Lover” and “Fallen Angel” were released as a digital EP with a third new song, “Heaven,” on streaming services the same day.

The title track has JENNIE singing, “Hey, can’t you stay?/ Don’t leave a fallen angel out here on her own/ Find a place/ Wherever we land is where we turn into a home.”

There’s more to come from Fallen Angel .

A physical CD release, which can be preordered from JENNIE’s webstore , features three additional new songs that are not available on streaming: “Sweettooth,” “Lockitdown” and “Face” round out the tracklist, making it a six-song EP. CD orders are currently expected to ship on Oct. 30.

Trailing behind  Fallen Angel on  Billboard ‘s poll this week are Olivia Rodrigo’s “Serena Joy,” Ky-Mani Marley’s Love and Energy , Alex Warren’s WILDCHILD and Alabama Shakes’ I Must Be Dreaming.
